name: generated-files
about: The mobile repo's runner trusts tools/toolset.txt (deny_write), but it is generated from tools.txt (generated: run regenerates it). Item a adds a tool and commits the toolset its generator makes: verify regenerates it at the head, finds the same bytes, and runs without the user's OK, so the PR opens and no Trust button is asked for. Item b writes the toolset by hand, bytes the generator does not make: verify refuses it as any trusted-file change and the item goes to the user with a Trust button (#593).

messages.text: needs you: verify did not run `[0-9a-f]{7}`, because it changes files the runner trusts \(deny_write\)(?s:.*)\[Trust this commit\]
